title: Nani's 70th near Schofields or Quakers Hill? 100% eggless, from Riverstone
summary:
A 70th birthday in Schofields or Quakers Hill usually means three generations at one table, and at least one grandparent who checks every ingredient. Every cake we make is 100% eggless. Not the sponge, not the buttercream, not one of the 15 flavours. Nobody has to ask.

A 10-inch serves 20-22 and starts at $74.99. Rasmalai and Mango tend to win over the older guests. The grandkids pick Chocolate anyway.

Send us a photo reference, give us two days' notice, and pick it up from Riverstone Shopping Centre. Free parking, open from 6am on weekdays. Pickup only. 🎂
